cases.description:
>CheckAllConstraints [](start = 17, length = 19)

This call is a substitute for the check that would be performed in `Binder.ConstructNamedType` if not suppressed. That check uses `conversions.WithNullability(true)` if the nullable feature is enabled.

evidence.thread_resolution: RikkiGibson: OK, sounds like I should check out Binder.ConstructNamedType or maybe other implementations of AfterAddingTypeMembersChecks and try to imitate where it calls conversions.WithNullability(true).
